summary: Mobile-health Network Solutions filed a 6-K reporting that on September 22, 2026, its board approved the allotment and issuance of 1,980,000 Class A ordinary shares and 500,000 Class C ordinary shares to six directors and officers as part of fiscal 2027 remuneration packages, subject to share transfer restrictions under a deed of undertaking. No price per share, stake percentage, premium, advisor, or board recommendation on a transaction is disclosed; shares are compensation-related equity grants rather than a special-situations event. Watch for dilution and transfer-restriction terms in subsequent filings.
